{"reason": "Replace the medium/high supplier-switch branch with alert-planner (35k, always in time) when inventory-days < 8, else monitor (free; regular lead ≤ 8 days). v1's 34 switches cost 1.53M and 4 stockouts (medium 5.3d with alt-lead 7; medium 2.8d with alt-lead 4); ample rows (11.5d, 12.4d, 13.2d) need no switch.","source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
          (< inventory-days 8))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else
     (list 'monitor))))"}
